04 · SCHEIDMANN ALLTAGSBEGLEITUNGUX/UI · Web Design · Digital Communication

Making everyday care easier to understand.

A digital experience designed to communicate everyday care services with greater clarity, warmth and reassurance for people looking for support for themselves or their loved ones.

Role
UX/UI Designer
Project
Academic project
Focus
Service communication
Output
Website · Digital touchpoints

The project

Designing clarity around care.

The project explored how Scheidmann Alltagsbegleitung could guide family caregivers and older people through everyday support options. The communication strategy focused on clear explanations, emotional reassurance and a consistent experience across the website, social media and email.

Clear information,
with a more human feel.

The project’s brand direction was calm, warm and reassuring. Simple language, visible contact options and practical service information were paired with human imagery to make the service feel approachable. The same tone and visual language carried into the supporting communication pieces.

Website

Bringing the service together in one place.

The website brings the service, support options and practical information into one continuous digital experience, using a clear structure and a warmer visual language throughout.

Beyond the website

Extending the experience across touchpoints.

The visual direction was also carried into supporting digital communication, creating a more consistent presence beyond the website.

Reflection

What I took from it.

This project made me think beyond individual pages and more about how a service communicates as a whole. Designing both the website and supporting digital touchpoints showed me how consistency in structure, tone and visual language can help create a clearer overall experience.
